prompt: What is the name of the town or city of birth of the player who won the men's singles at the US Open on the year after Venus & Serena Williams played each other for the 8th time as pros?
answer:
The 8th professional meeting between Venus and Serena Williams was at the **2001 US Open**. The following year, **Pete Sampras** won the 2002 US Open men’s singles title.  

Sampras was born in **Washington, D.C.**
